ezekiel.22.p1.b1.text: As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations

ezekiel.22.p1.b2.text: Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.

ezekiel.22.p1.b3.text: You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten

ezekiel.22.p1.b4.text: Now look, I strike My hands together against your unjust gain and against the blood you have shed in your midst.

ezekiel.22.p1.b5.text: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands

ezekiel.22.p2.b1.text: Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.

ezekiel.22.p2.b2.text: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted within the city.

ezekiel.22.p2.b3.text: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey.

ezekiel.22.p2.b4.text: Her priests do violence to My law … They disregard My Sabbaths

ezekiel.22.p2.b5.text: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey

ezekiel.22.p2.b6.text: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land … But I found no one.
